text:
ida_fin: Heads-up — Sentinel Retainer (acct SR-6620) is overdue: 4 invoices, $83,200 total, oldest 66 days. Collections reports client says their AR was frozen pending internal fraud review and they want to send ACH from a new bank. Theyre disputing a $4,200 usage line on INV-20240730 and are threatening counsel if we escalate. @tess_support @noah_sales can we triage?

billing-bot: System note: invoices: INV-20240501 ($20,000), INV-20240601 ($22,500), INV-20240701 ($18,500), INV-20240730 ($22,200). Last payment: $0 in 2024. Collections vendor: Harbor Collections, outreach started 2024-09-02.

leo_collections: They've been avoiding calls. Recommend short hold while we attempt negotiation, but we need a firm commitment date or resume full dunning. They mentioned "outside counsel" a couple times.

tess_support: I can open a 60-minute portal unlock for ACH entry after we verify bank docs. Workflow: open ticket, run KYC/fraud checks, then run `/unlock-portal --acct=SR-6620 --window=60m --by=tess_support`. Uploads must use secure intake: https://vault.redwood/payments-upload. No DMs.

noah_sales: My suggestion: offer a one-time goodwill settlement of 3% of outstanding if they pay 100% within 7 days, or a payment plan: 50% now, 25% in 30 days, 25% in 60 days with signed schedule. Also offer to waive the disputed $4,200 if they complete payment during unlock. Will take client comms if finance approves.

ida_fin: Policy note: provisional credits up to $2,500 can be applied by finance ops; above that needs CFO sign-off and AR reserve tagging. The disputed $4,200 requires CFO approval for any provisional write-off.

raj_rfo: (typo)

raj_cfo: Approve conditional actions: 1) provisional write-off/credit of up to $4,200 to resolve dispute, conditional on signed 14-day reconciliation & release; 2) allow 60-minute portal unlock after KYC + voided check or micro-deposit verification; 3) pause collections vendor outreach until 2024-09-10 COB. Add account note: "PROV_CREDIT_4200_RAJ_2024-09-03". No extended payment plans without exec sign-off on >$50k AR.

tess_support: Creating ticket SB-95721 and will run fraud checks. Standing by for uploads and will attach verification logs.

leo_collections: Pausing outreach until 2024-09-10. If no signed ack/payment, resume escalation 2024-09-11.

noah_sales: I'll message the client now with the offer and request upload to intake link. Will CC collections & finance.

ida_fin: I'll prepare the provisional credit entry and AR reserve note once we get the signed release and payment. Thanks — will update SB-95721 with GL entry code MR-AR-WO when applied. :white_check_mark:
